summary: Bulk Update Time and Material Equipment logs
description: Bulk update Time and Material Equipment logs with one request.

schema.description: Array of Time and material equipment logs

id.description: Unique identifier of the Time & Material equipment log.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the equipment usage (e.g., hours, each, days).

quantity.description: Quantity of equipment used, in the specified unit of measure.

idle_quantity.description: Quantity of time the equipment sat idle, in the specified unit of measure.

project_id.description: Identifier of the project this equipment log belongs to.

time_and_material_entry_id.description: Identifier of the Time & Material entry this equipment log belongs to.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment log was last modified, in ISO 8601 format.

created_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment log was created, in ISO 8601 format.

deleted_at.description: Timestamp when this equipment log was soft-deleted, in ISO 8601 format. Null if the record is active.

id.description: Unique identifier of the user who created this equipment log.

login.description: Email address of the user who created this equipment log.

name.description: Full name of the user who created this equipment log.

time_and_material_equipment_logs.description: Array of Time and material equipment log objects

time_and_material_entry_id.description: Identifier of the Time & Material entry this equipment log belongs to.

uom.description: Unit of measure for the equipment usage (e.g., hours, each, days).

quantity.description: Quantity of equipment used, in the specified unit of measure.

idle_quantity.description: Idle hours for the Time And Material Equipment Log
